title: That stabbing SIDE STITCH when you run: what is it? 🏃
caption:
About 7 in 10 runners get one in a year. Leading theory: the lining of your belly wall gets irritated, and a full stomach makes it worse. Do you get side stitches? 👇

Why Does This Happen? #4
first_comment: What actually stops YOUR side stitch? 🏃
sources: Morton D, Callister R. Exercise-related transient abdominal pain (ETAP). Sports Med 2015;45:23-35 (about 70% of runners in the past year; parietal peritoneum irritation theory; food and fluid before exercise make it worse; avoid large volumes 2 h before)
Morton DP, Callister R. Characteristics and etiology of exercise-related transient abdominal pain. Med Sci Sports Exerc 2000;32:432-438
